verdict.rationale: Docs mention that TruffleHog can 'Route findings to Slack, Jira, email, or webhooks so the right people can act on them' and can 'Set up alerts across the platform of your choosing,' indicating outbound webhook notifications for scan findings exist. However, there is no detail on webhook subscription setup, event types, payload schema, or an API/OpenAPI spec (openapi probe returned 404), so it's unclear how a user would programmatically subscribe to and consume these events. Missing for 10: webhook configuration docs, event schema/payload details, API reference for subscribing, independent confirmation of webhook reliability.
